name: humanizer-fr
description: Humanize French and English prose by removing recurring AI-writing patterns while preserving meaning, facts, voice, and source constraints.

interface.longDescription: Rewrites AI-sounding French and English prose so it reads naturally while preserving supported facts, meaning, citations, technical content and the writer's voice. Includes French-specific LLM patterns and corporate-language tells.
interface.defaultPrompt: Humanize this text without changing its meaning or inventing facts. If it is French, apply the French-specific patterns first.

prompts: Reformule ce texte professionnel en français sans changer les faits, les chiffres ni mon ton.
Relis ce document intégralement par segments et indique les sections couvertes avant de le réécrire.
Rends ce message plus naturel en conservant les termes métiers utiles.

publication.release_notes: Preserves the French rules and factual fidelity safeguards. Adds French visual branding, publisher website, support, privacy policy and terms for public distribution.
